Quick Start Designed for PO / WhatsApp / Quotation workflows
Quotation: choose Cash or Credit, choose VAT mode, select customer, add items from Item Master, then Save & Generate PDF.
Pro Forma: convert an existing quotation with selected items only, or create a standalone PI from a PO / WhatsApp order.
Attachments: PDF / JPG / JPEG / PNG can be attached and previewed. PDF/text auto-read is available when the browser can load the optional reader library.
Production QR: every PI carries a production payload. Set the Production System URL in Settings for one-scan import when both files are hosted.
